issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 04 requires counting swimming pools in municipalities with more than 1000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses a threshold of 2000 (Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 2000). This semantic mismatch between the specified numeric condition and the solution's implementation will produce different results and confuse students about the correct requirement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric threshold consistent. Either update the solution to use Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000 to match the problem statement, or revise the problem text to require 'mehr als 2000' if the intended threshold is 2000. Ensure the template and solution use the same condition so students are not confused.
